name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Alriiight, we're here. You gonna do what I think you're gonna do?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Y'know, the ritual. This place should work."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Sooo~, we're back here again, which means..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You gonna do the ritual after all?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Alright, let's go then. We still gotta find Shiorin."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Well, whatever. If you're not doing it, then let's go~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Aye aye, okay, first step... uh, what was it again? I forgot. Okay, you handle this."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, next is uhh, right. The chant."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "That's hilarious. This is way too sketchy."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Huh? What, you want me to do it with you?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Okay, okay, I get it. Geez, stop looking at me like that. I'll do it, alright?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Now go do the chant. 'Cause I don't remember any of it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "The cosmos's in the firmament or whatever~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Uh, what's with the face? I made sure to follow your lead!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Okay, maybe I *did* half-ass the last part, but your chant was perfect, right? Ain't that good enough?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "And even if it fails, it's not like it's on me. I mean, that occult girl said it too, remember? No one really knows if it's real."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Fine, okay, okay. I get it. One more time, yeah? Properly this time. Alright, alright, I'll do it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ugh, what a pain. It's not like anything'll happen if we do it prop—"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Is it me or... did it just get darker all of a sudden?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh? Eh? Wh-Wh-What the heck's with this light?! Wait, what?!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey, this is bad! We gotta bail or—huh? What, whaaat?!"
